about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Yusuf, a 24-year-old Computer Engineering graduate from FSMVÜ. I have experience with Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, and React. My primary focus has been on backend software development, where I have worked extensively with the Java Spring Framework across multiple projects. I have also contributed to a company-level project developed using Spring, gaining hands-on experience in real-world software development processes. I worked on react side of projects as well at the same company.
about.paragraph2: I am highly adaptable and capable of learning new technologies and tools quickly. I trust my ability to take on new challenges and continuously improve myself in dynamic environments.
about.paragraph3: With advanced English proficiency, I can efficiently utilize global resources and actively contribute to international projects. My goal is to be part of innovative and leading software companies, where I can apply my problem-solving skills, creative thinking, and continuous learning mindset to develop high-value software solutions.
